GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (30 Aug 48) GA
(SCAPIN - 1934/1)
APO 500
15 November 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Display of Japanese National Flag.
1. Reference is made to Central Liaison and Coordination Office letter No. 3565 (FCR No. 97) dated 15 October 1948, subject, "Application for Approval of Displaying of Japanese National Flag at the Reception Centers."
2. The Japanese national flag may be displayed in accordance with the following instructions at the ports of Sasebo, Maizuru and Hakodate debarking Japanese repatriates:
a. Only one flag of a size to be determined by the Japanese Government may be displayed on a pole in a place clearly visible from the harbor and conspicuous to the landing site of the ship or ships debarking Japanese repatriates.
b. This flag may be displayed only from the time the repatriation ship arrives in the harbor until the debarking procedure is complete.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
